# Anurag Vishwakarma

> Portfolio of Anurag Vishwakarma, a Diploma CSE student and builder from Bhopal, India. CSE student. Builder. One live prototype at a time.

Anurag Vishwakarma is a Diploma in Computer Science Engineering student at S.V. Polytechnic College, Bhopal, India. He builds web products end to end with Next.js, TypeScript, React and Python, and explores systems in depth — Linux (including Arch Linux installed from scratch), Android custom ROMs, and how large language models work (transformer architecture, self-attention, embeddings). His featured project is Krishi Setu, a live prototype of an agricultural marketplace. He completed a 4-week Generative AI internship at SGSU, where he also taught concepts to classmates. He is open to internships.

## Portfolio Sections

- [What I Do](https://anurag-web-portfolio.vercel.app/#what-i-do): Building, learning and teaching — skills and approach
- [Projects](https://anurag-web-portfolio.vercel.app/#projects): Shipped work, led by the Krishi Setu live prototype
- [Journey](https://anurag-web-portfolio.vercel.app/#journey): Timeline from first code to the Krishi Setu prototype
- [How I Work](https://anurag-web-portfolio.vercel.app/#how-i-work): Working method and principles
- [Contact](https://anurag-web-portfolio.vercel.app/#contact): Ways to get in touch

## Projects

- [Krishi Setu — live prototype](https://krishi-setu-lovat.vercel.app): Agricultural marketplace prototype built with Next.js 15 and TypeScript for the Smart India Hackathon, with team Krishi Mitra. Escrow-style payment release via a 4-digit handover PIN, OpenCV quality pre-check, 5-factor match score and hyperlocal discovery under 25 km. A working prototype, not a product in real use
- [Krishi Setu — source code](https://github.com/itsanuragv/krishi-setu): GitHub repository for Krishi Setu
- [Portfolio — source code](https://github.com/build-with-anurag/portfolio): Source code of this portfolio site
